question:
Find the circumference of a circle that circumscribes a square of side 7 cm.

(Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the square = 7 cm

**Formula Used:**

Diameter of the circumscribed circle = Diagonal of the square

Circumference of the circle = π × Diameter

Diagonal of the square = side × √2

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7af76aef68d95ca1eafa381154ab155f4e1056a77e48cbaf91e4c6ff05ecbd94.png] 

Diagonal of the square = 7 × √2

Diameter of the circumscribed circle = 7√2 cm

Circumference = π × Diameter

Circumference = (22)/(7) × 7sqrt{2}

⇒ Circumference = 22√2 cm

**The circumference of the circle that circumscribes the square is 22√2 cm.**
